en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor café or beer garden in front of a small brick pavilion surrounded by large trees. Several people sit at tables with bentwood chairs; a server appears near the right. The building has tall multi‑pane windows and a central door with brick arches above the windows. On the right edge of the card, part of the reverse or margin is visible with ornate printed lettering, likely the photographer's imprint, and chalk or pencil numbers.
